original.prompt: Consider the following statements about the second India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue held in June 2026:
items: Australia was represented by its Deputy Prime Minister, Richard Marles.
The dialogue was held in Singapore on the sidelines of the Shangri-La Dialogue.
The inaugural round of the dialogue was held in Australia in October 2025.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: The dialogue was held in New Delhi, not Singapore. Marles arrived straight from the Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore. The dialogue runs under the two countries' Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, and its agenda covered interoperability and defence-industrial co-development and co-production.
original.source: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Australian Deputy Prime Minister Richard Marles will co-chair the second India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue in New Delhi on 1 June.
